requirements.title: User authentication
requirements.description: Users must be able to register with an email and password, sign in to obtain a session token, and sign out to revoke the session.

requirements.title: Role-based permissions
requirements.description: Administrators must be able to assign roles and manage which team members can create, edit, or archive work items.

requirements.title: Assignment notifications
requirements.description: The system must send a real-time alert to a user whenever a work item is assigned to them.

requirements.title: File attachments
requirements.description: Users must be able to upload files to a work item and download previously attached files.

tasks.title: Implement email/password registration endpoint
tasks.description: Create an endpoint that registers a new user account with an email and password.

tasks.title: Add sign-in and sign-out endpoints
tasks.description: Sign-in issues a session token; sign-out revokes it.

tasks.title: Add admin role management API
tasks.description: Allow admins to assign roles to team members.

tasks.title: Enforce permission checks on work items
tasks.description: Block create/edit/archive actions unless the caller's role permits them.

tasks.title: Send real-time notification on assignment
tasks.description: Notify the assignee in real time when a work item is assigned to them.

tasks.title: Add file upload endpoint for work items
tasks.description: Upload files and attach them to a work item.

tasks.title: Add file download endpoint
tasks.description: Download previously attached files for a work item.

tasks.title: Credential-based account lifecycle
tasks.description: Implement account creation, login, and logout using email/password credentials and auth cookies.

tasks.title: Admin controls for member access levels
tasks.description: Let administrators grant access tiers and decide who may create, change, or retire project items.

tasks.title: Instant alerts when items change hands
tasks.description: Push a live alert to a colleague the moment a work item is handed over to them.

tasks.title: Document attachments on cards
tasks.description: Support attaching documents to a card and fetching stored documents later.

tasks.title: Login page UI
tasks.description: Build the login screen with email and password fields and a submit button.

tasks.title: Team member directory
tasks.description: Show the list of team members and their current access levels.

tasks.title: Activity feed
tasks.description: Display a feed of recent changes to work items.

tasks.title: Card detail drawer
tasks.description: Render the detail view of a work item including metadata and comments.

tasks.title: Dark mode styling
tasks.description: Add a dark theme to the application shell.

tasks.title: Authentication settings page
tasks.description: A settings screen where users can view account details. It does not register, sign in, or issue tokens.

tasks.title: Permission labels in UI
tasks.description: Display read-only badges showing the current role of each team member. No role assignment or enforcement.

tasks.title: Notification preferences screen
tasks.description: A screen to toggle notification preferences. It does not send alerts when work items are assigned.

tasks.title: Attachment icon in card header
tasks.description: Show an attachment icon when a work item has files. No upload or download functionality.
